name: Momose Yuzuki
source:
A “gyaru” type girl.
The class leader, and Renji's main bully.
Creating an the perfect atmosphere to bully Renji by involving others, she also torments Renji herself. Her goal is not to curry favor with him, but because she is a bully at heart.

 “Are you at least prepared to be the target of bullying yourself?”
